findings.summary: Deterministic sample check for R2 misattributes coverage to milestones M1/M2, but the plan schedules AT2 (static-only output verification including search/tags/backlinks) in M3 (and again in M4 E2E). This makes the trace graph sample check semantically inconsistent with the plan’s milestone/test placement.

evidence.note: Sample check for R2 lists milestones M1/M2 and AT2

evidence.quote: Tests for client-side search functionality (AT5), search quality (AT12), and static-only output verification (AT2).

evidence.note: M3 exit criteria requires AT2 pass criteria
evidence.quote: Generated output contains only static files; site functions without server-side runtime (AT2 pass criteria).

evidence.note: M4 also references AT2 in E2E acceptance
evidence.quote: E2E acceptance test with all plugins enabled on representative dataset (AT13, AT2).

evidence.note: AT2 checks static-only output with all core features functioning without server-side runtime
